body.x: [Pipeline Position] Senior Training Lead (Africa Regional Office) [Based in Kigali]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking a Senior Training Lead for 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Africa Regional Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Kigali, Rwanda. (Duty station: Kigali, Rwanda)

This role is responsible for the technical aspects of transferring, adapting and delivering VEA4A’s GxP+, MSAT, Advanced Regulatory Science and Train-the-Trainer programmes in Rwanda. It encompasses the review of training materials, assessment of trainer and delivery readiness, monitoring of training quality and progressive transfer of training to participating HEIs, under the general guidance of the Program Director.
1. Technical transfer and training package development
Facilitate and document the technical transfer from IVI HQ and pathway specialists during Years 1 and 2.
Review and adapt GxP+, MSAT, Advanced Regulatory Science and TTT training packages, drawing on technical input from relevant IVI pathway specialists.
Review competency frameworks, curricula, trainer guides, participant materials, assessments and technical digital content against the relevant IVI guidance, and provide recommendations for approval.
Identify technical, laboratory, facility, equipment, biosafety and practical-delivery requirements for each pathway with guidance from relevant IVI specialists.
Coordinate HQ pathway leads, IVI specialists, HEI faculty, regulators, manufacturers, external lecturers and technical providers.
Lead faculty mapping, faculty development, TTT, mentoring and trainer assessment, and facilitate trainer clearance.
Assess technical readiness before training cycles, including content, trainers, facilities, practical components and assessments, and report findings to the Program Director.
Coordinate IVI-supported technical delivery and monitor the quality of HEI-led delivery.
3. Training quality monitoring and transfer to HEIs
Facilitate technical review, assessment moderation, remediation and continuous improvement, and follow up on corrective actions.
Review training materials and delivery against validated industry and regulatory competency requirements.
Facilitate the progressive transfer of curricula, faculty capability, delivery processes and quality-assurance practices to HEIs.
Advanced degree in biomanufacturing, biotechnology, pharmacy, biological sciences, engineering, regulatory science, education or another relevant field.
7+ years with Master’s degree; 4+ years with Doctoral degree
Demonstrated experience in technical training, curriculum development, faculty development or quality assurance in a relevant sector.
Strong understanding of adult learning, competency-based training, assessment and practical or workplace-linked education.
Relevant experience in vaccine manufacturing, biomanufacturing, GxP, MSAT, quality systems or regulatory science.
Experience working with universities, technical institutions, manufacturers or regulators, preferably in Africa.
Ability to work with multidisciplinary specialists and provide sound technical-quality recommendations.
Understanding of curriculum and assessment governance.
Collaboration with specialists from different disciplines.
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
